description: A WinUI 3 self-contained single-file publish crashes with XamlParseException after the published executable is renamed, from https://github.com/microsoft/WindowsAppSDK/issues/6248.
prompt:
My packaged bits run until I rename the published exe for branding, then the app dies before the first window opens. I changed `NorthstarShell.exe` to `NorthstarShellLauncher.exe` in `bin\publish`.

```
Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Markup.XamlParseException: XAML parsing failed.
   at Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application.LoadComponent(Object, Uri, ComponentResourceLocation)
   at NorthstarShell.MainWindow.InitializeComponent()
   at NorthstarShell.App.OnLaunched(LaunchActivatedEventArgs args)
```
